text: Unfortunately, I cannot leave the rave review I originally thought I would.  My first visit was a great experience. Kima did my nails, and she was excellent. I was very happy with the service and fully intended to continue coming back. Kima was compassionate, kind and a good listener as to what I wanted, and how I wanted my nails.  My second experience, however, was completely different. During a previous conversation, I had simply asked the owner, Louisa, about eyebrow services for my mother-in-law. I specifically said that I would get back in touch if she was interested. I never contacted the salon again about the eyebrow service because my mother-in-law was not interested, especially at the quoted price of $300.  When I later called the salon to verify my upcoming nail appointment, Louisa immediately told me that I had missed an eyebrow appointment and that the eyebrow technician had been there waiting for me. I was extremely confused because I had never scheduled an eyebrow appointment.  Louisa stated that she had sent me a text regarding the appointment. I checked my regular messages, spam, WhatsApp, and even my email to make sure I had not overlooked anything. I found no message, confirmation, reminder, or communication showing that an eyebrow appointment had ever been scheduled.  I tried to explain that I had only inquired about the service and had never actually booked anything, but I did not feel that my concerns were being heard. I was simply calling to verify my nail appointment.  Louisa then told me she would text me the date and time of my nail appointment. That text never came either.  At that point, I decided to find another salon where appointments are clearly confirmed by text, phone, or email so there is no confusion.  It is disappointing because my first experience with Kima was genuinely excellent, and I really liked the salon. Unfortunately, based on my communication experience with the owner, I will not be returning.
